dbToolScopingDenylist.icp_personas: Legacy/frozen as of the shared-personas migration (see server/db/schema.ts) -- personas now live in packages/shared's sharedPersonas; kept only so historical rows still resolve.
dbToolScopingDenylist.api_tokens: Has a user_email column (not owner_email) that already scopes every row to its owner -- naming convention mismatch, not an unscoped table.
dbToolScopingDenylist.prospect_tag_links: Join table scoped indirectly via prospect_id -> prospects.owner_email; no direct owner column of its own.
dbToolScopingDenylist.feedback: Has a nullable user_email column that already scopes attributed rows to their owner -- naming convention mismatch, not an unscoped table. Anonymous feedback is intentionally allowed (null).
dbToolScopingDenylist.workspace_settings: Singleton key-value config store by design (single-workspace deployment), not per-user data.
dbToolScopingDenylist.hubspot_queue_items: Scoped indirectly via queue_id -> hubspot_queues.owner_email; no direct owner column of its own.
dbToolScopingDenylist.lead_list_items: Scoped indirectly via list_id -> lead_lists.owner_email; no direct owner column of its own.
dbToolScopingDenylist.icp_sources: Legacy singleton fallback table (single 'singleton' row) for a workspace with no personas at all -- not per-user data.
dbToolScopingDenylist.rate_limit_counters: Infra rate-limit bucket keyed by "<ownerEmail>|<action>" composite id (see server/helpers/rate-limit.ts) -- already owner-scoped via the id itself, not a separate column.
